source_index_lines: - [[users-hsu-research-mfl-6]] — maker-store and forum user reports (Tier E, anecdotal)
brand_notes: MFL-6 is Hsu's multi-function (L/C/R/surround/Atmos) speaker with 45-degree slanted baffle and Don Keele horn; ASR measured elevated top octave and woofer resonance and did not recommend it (asr-hsu-research-mfl-6); S&V liked it (soundandvision-hsu-research-mfl-6). Sound & Vision cites a 92 dB rating (conditions unstated).
takeaways: Slanted-panel multi-function speaker, measured on 90-degree-to-baffle design axis
Strongly elevated upper treble and woofer resonance near 2.5 kHz; LW ±3.8 dB, pref 3.4
f3 80 Hz so needs a sub; sensitivity 85.5 dB
Distortion fine at 86 dB, high at 96 dB, ok at 91 dB
Sound & Vision found it smooth and detailed, contradicting ASR's treble finding
conflicts: Treble: S&V smooth vs ASR strongly elevated
Claimed 92 dB (S&V, conditions unstated) vs 85.5 dB computed full-space
